versions.subject: rule: Winrar suspicious folder
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: 
        - '\rar.exe'
        - '\winrar.exe'
    - Description: 'Command line RAR'
filter:
    Image|contains: '\WinRAR'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\rar.exe", "*\\winrar.exe") OR Description="Command line RAR" NOT Image="*\\WinRAR*"

versions.subject: fix: exclusions in new WinRAR rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith: 
        - '\rar.exe'
        - '\winrar.exe'
    - Description: 'Command line RAR'
filter:
    Image|contains: 
        - '\WinRAR'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp'
        - '\UnRAR.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\rar.exe", "*\\winrar.exe") OR Description="Command line RAR" NOT (Image IN ("*\\WinRAR*", "*C:\\Windows\\Temp*", "*\\UnRAR.exe*"))

versions.subject: Merge PR #4406 from @nasbench - Multiple Updates & Additions
versions.detection:
selection:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\rar.exe'
        - '\winrar.exe'
    - Description: 'Command line RAR'
filter_main_unrar:
    # Note: we filter unrar as it has the same description as the other utilities, and we're only interested in compression
    Image|endswith: '\UnRAR.exe'
filter_main_path:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\WinRAR\'
        - ':\Program Files\WinRAR\'
filter_optional_temp:
    # Note: in some occasion installers were seen dropping "rar" in TEMP
    Image|contains: ':\Windows\Temp\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\rar.exe", "*\\winrar.exe") OR Description="Command line RAR" NOT (Image="*\\UnRAR.exe" OR Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\WinRAR\\*", "*:\\Program Files\\WinRAR\\*")) NOT Image="*:\\Windows\\Temp\\*"
